title: Cookies and trackers (France, CNIL)
description: Select when the website or mobile application writes or reads cookies, local storage or device identifiers on the devices of users in France, beyond those that Art. 82 of loi n° 78-17 exempts; it is not preselected for a sector, since any sector can need it. It adds the CNIL guidelines and recommendation to the tracker rule of the gdpr pack (EU).

sources.title: CNIL, Délibération n° 2020-091, lignes directrices relatives à l'application de l'article 82 de la loi du 6 janvier 1978 (cookies et autres traceurs)
